reconstructed_theorem_text:
For every finite-dimensional real inner product space E, with its compatible norm and additive group structure, for every pair of functions f, g: E -> R, and for every point x in E, if f and g are each twice continuously Frechet differentiable locally at x, then

Delta(f * g)(x) = f(x) * Delta g(x) + 2 * <grad f(x), grad g(x)> + g(x) * Delta f(x),

where f * g denotes the pointwise product z |-> f(z) * g(z), <., .> is the given real inner product, grad h(x) is the Riesz representative of the Frechet derivative of h at x, and Delta h(x) is the inner-product trace of the second Frechet derivative of h at x (the canonical-covariant-tensor Laplacian). The differentiability assumptions are local at this same point x; no global smoothness is assumed. The assertion includes dimension-zero E and does not require E to be nontrivial.
